epics.title: AI Dialogue Engine
epics.jtbd: When a lead replies to a cold message, I want the AI to conduct a natural conversation, so that unqualified leads are filtered and qualified ones are identified.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce prompt configuration error rate to <1%
requirements: R1: Data schema must support storing configurable prompt templates containing AI persona, sales goal, tone of voice, product FAQs, and qualification rules
R2: API must allow reading and updating the prompt template configurations
R3: Svelte frontend must provide a UI for administrators to customize AI persona and related prompt settings

slices.title: AI Persona Configuration Data Schema
slices.jtbd: When implementing data storage for this epic, I want a schema to save prompt configurations, so that AI agents can load persona settings dynamically
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PostgreSQL database, When executing migrations, Then a new table is created via V1__create_prompt_config.sql.
Given the table exists, When inspecting it, Then it contains fields for persona, tone, FAQs, and qualification rules.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce db schema migration errors to 0

slices.title: AI Persona API Contract
slices.jtbd: When implementing the API contract for this epic, I want to define endpoints for prompt config, so that backend and frontend can be developed in parallel
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the OpenAPI specification, When reviewing the document, Then GET and PUT endpoints for prompt configuration are defined in openapi.yaml.
Given the endpoints, When checking schemas, Then they strictly define fields for persona, sales goal, tone, FAQs, and qualification rules.

slices.title: AI Persona Backend API
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to expose endpoints for prompt configuration, so that the frontend can read and update persona settings
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid PUT request with prompt config data, When it is sent to the API, Then PromptConfigController.java processes and saves it.
Given a saved config, When a GET request is made, Then the API returns the correct JSON payload.

slices.title: AI Persona Customization UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI for this epic, I want a form to customize prompt templates, so that admins can easily define AI persona and rules
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Svelte dashboard, When the user navigates to AI settings, Then PromptConfig.svelte renders the configuration form.
Given the form is filled, When submitted, Then the component sends a PUT request to the API and displays a success message.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce UI input validation errors by 100%
